Fotballklubben Bodø/Glimt, also referred to as Bodø/Glimt or its former name Glimt (\"Gleam\"), is a Norwegian professional football club from the city of Bodø in Bodø Municipality, Nordland county, Norway. The club currently plays in Eliteserien, the Norwegian top division. The club was founded on 19 September 1916.
